examples.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
examples.zh: 這些蛋大約三週後會孵化。

examples.en: Several chicks hatched on the farm this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上農場裡有幾隻小雞孵出來了。

examples.en: The hen sat on the nest to hatch her eggs.
examples.zh: 母雞坐在巢裡孵牠的蛋。

examples.en: The sailor opened the hatch and climbed down to the engine room.
examples.zh: 水手打開艙口，爬下去機房。

examples.en: Please keep the hatch closed during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間請保持艙門關閉。

examples.en: A small hatch in the floor led to the storage room.
examples.zh: 地板上的一個小艙口通往儲藏室。

examples.en: The farmer stored the hay in the barn for winter.
examples.zh: 農夫把乾草存放在穀倉裡過冬。

examples.en: The horses ate fresh hay after a long ride.
examples.zh: 馬匹在長途騎乘後吃了新鮮的乾草。

examples.en: We lay on the soft hay and watched the stars.
examples.zh: 我們躺在柔軟的乾草上看星星。

examples.en: The headline on the front page caught my attention.
examples.zh: 頭版的標題引起了我的注意。

examples.en: Her success made the headlines in every local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她的成功登上了每家地方報紙的頭條。

examples.en: Read the headline first to understand what the article is about.
examples.zh: 先讀標題，就能知道文章在講什麼。

examples.en: The company's headquarters is located in downtown Taipei.
examples.zh: 這家公司的總部位於台北市中心。

examples.en: Our team will report to headquarters every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們團隊每週一早上都要向總部報告。

examples.en: The police set up their headquarters near the stadium for the event.
examples.zh: 警方在體育場附近設置了這次活動的指揮部。

examples.en: It took two months for the broken arm to heal.
examples.zh: 斷掉的手臂花了兩個月才痊癒。

examples.en: Time can heal even the deepest sadness.
examples.zh: 時間能撫平再深的悲傷。

examples.en: The nurse said the cream would heal the cut quickly.
examples.zh: 護理師說這種藥膏能讓傷口很快癒合。

examples.en: There was a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
examples.zh: 地板上有一堆髒衣服。

examples.en: He left a heap of books on my desk.
examples.zh: 他在我的書桌上留下一堆書。

examples.en: I have heaps of homework to finish tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚有一大堆功課要寫完。

examples.en: She heaped rice onto my plate.
examples.zh: 她把飯堆在我的盤子上。

examples.en: The workers heaped the sand beside the road.
examples.zh: 工人把沙子堆在路邊。

examples.en: Do not heap too many boxes on the shelf.
examples.zh: 不要在架子上堆太多箱子。

examples.en: I have a blister on my left heel.
examples.zh: 我的左腳跟起了水泡。

examples.en: She wore shoes with high heels to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿著高跟鞋去參加婚禮。

examples.en: The heel of this sock has a small hole.
examples.zh: 這隻襪子的腳跟處有一個小洞。

examples.en: Some people believe in heaven and hell after death.
examples.zh: 有些人相信人死後有天堂和地獄。

examples.en: The old painting shows a scene of hell with fire and smoke.
examples.zh: 這幅古畫描繪了充滿火焰與濃煙的地獄景象。

examples.en: Walking in the hot sun all day felt like hell.
examples.zh: 在大太陽下走了一整天，感覺像是活受罪。

examples.en: You must wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
examples.zh: 騎機車時一定要戴安全帽。

examples.en: The workers put on their helmets before entering the site.
examples.zh: 工人們進入工地前先戴上安全帽。

examples.en: My brother bought a new helmet for his bicycle.
examples.zh: 我哥哥為他的腳踏車買了一頂新安全帽。

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to ask if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果有任何問題，請不要猶豫，儘管發問。

examples.en: She hesitated before opening the door.
examples.zh: 她在開門前遲疑了一下。

examples.en: He hesitated for a moment and then signed the form.
examples.zh: 他猶豫了一會兒，然後簽了表格。

examples.en: Can you give me a hint about the answer?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一點答案的提示嗎？

examples.en: There was a hint of sadness in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的聲音裡帶著一絲悲傷。

examples.en: The teacher dropped a hint about the test.
examples.zh: 老師透露了一點關於考試的暗示。

examples.en: He hinted that he might change jobs next year.
examples.zh: 他暗示明年可能會換工作。

examples.en: My sister hinted that she wanted a book for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我姊姊暗示她生日想要一本書。

examples.en: The manager hinted at a possible pay raise.
examples.zh: 經理暗示可能會加薪。

examples.en: The historian wrote a book about life in ancient Rome.
examples.zh: 這位歷史學家寫了一本關於古羅馬生活的書。

examples.en: Our class invited a local historian to give a talk.
examples.zh: 我們班邀請了一位當地的歷史學家來演講。

examples.en: Historians study old letters to learn about the past.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究舊信件來了解過去。

senses.zh: 有歷史意義的；歷史上著名的

examples.en: Tourists visit the historic temple in the old town.
examples.zh: 遊客造訪老城區裡具歷史意義的古廟。

examples.en: The two leaders signed a historic agreement yesterday.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人昨天簽署了一項歷史性的協議。

examples.en: This historic building was built over two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 這棟古蹟建築是兩百多年前蓋的。

examples.en: The tree trunk was hollow inside.
examples.zh: 這棵樹的樹幹裡面是空心的。

examples.en: The sick boy had hollow cheeks and tired eyes.
examples.zh: 那個生病的男孩雙頰凹陷，眼神疲憊。

examples.en: His promise sounded hollow to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他的承諾在房裡每個人聽來都很空洞。

examples.en: Many people travel to the holy city every year.
examples.zh: 每年有許多人前往這座聖城。

examples.en: The temple is a holy place for local families.
examples.zh: 這座廟對當地家庭來說是神聖的地方。

examples.en: They read the holy book together every Sunday.
examples.zh: 他們每個星期天一起讀聖經。

examples.en: It is an honor to meet you.
examples.zh: 很榮幸能見到你。

examples.en: The students stood up in honor of their old teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們起立向他們的老老師致敬。

examples.en: She won first place and brought honor to our school.
examples.zh: 她贏得第一名，為我們學校爭光。

examples.en: The school will honor the winners at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 學校將在典禮上表揚得獎者。

examples.en: We should honor our parents and grandparents.
examples.zh: 我們應該尊敬父母與祖父母。

examples.en: The store promised to honor the coupon until Friday.
examples.zh: 這家店承諾在週五前都接受這張優惠券。

examples.en: The students felt hopeful about the exam results.
examples.zh: 學生們對考試結果感到有希望。

examples.en: She gave her mother a hopeful smile.
examples.zh: 她對媽媽露出充滿期待的微笑。

examples.en: We are hopeful that the rain will stop soon.
examples.zh: 我們希望雨很快就會停。

examples.en: The driver pressed the horn to warn the cyclist.
examples.zh: 司機按喇叭提醒腳踏車騎士。

examples.en: My cousin plays the horn in the school band.
examples.zh: 我表哥在學校樂隊吹法國號。

examples.en: The bull has two sharp horns on its head.
examples.zh: 這頭公牛頭上有兩隻尖角。

senses.zh: 恐怖；驚駭；令人害怕的事

examples.en: She screamed in horror when she saw the huge spider.
examples.zh: 她看到巨大的蜘蛛時嚇得尖叫。

examples.en: We watched a horror movie on Halloween night.
examples.zh: 萬聖節晚上我們看了一部恐怖片。

examples.en: The horror of the accident stayed in his mind for years.
examples.zh: 那場意外的恐怖記憶在他心中停留了好幾年。

examples.en: The bus runs on an hourly schedule on Sundays.
examples.zh: 星期天公車每小時一班。

examples.en: He earns an hourly wage at the coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他在咖啡店領時薪。

examples.en: Please check the hourly weather report before you go hiking.
examples.zh: 去健行前請先看每小時的天氣預報。

examples.en: The trains leave hourly for the airport.
examples.zh: 前往機場的火車每小時發一班。

examples.en: The nurse checks on the patient hourly.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時查看病人一次。

examples.en: The website updates the news hourly.
examples.zh: 這個網站每小時更新一次新聞。

senses.zh: 管家；家務管理員；房務人員

examples.en: The housekeeper cleans the whole house every Friday.
examples.zh: 管家每週五打掃整間屋子。

examples.en: The hotel housekeeper changed the towels in our room.
examples.zh: 飯店的房務人員幫我們換了房間的毛巾。

examples.en: They hired a housekeeper to help with the cooking and cleaning.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位管家來幫忙煮飯和打掃。

examples.en: She hums a tune while she cooks dinner.
examples.zh: 她一邊煮晚餐一邊哼著曲子。

examples.en: The refrigerator hums quietly in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 冰箱在廚房裡安靜地嗡嗡作響。

examples.en: Bees hummed around the flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花園的花朵周圍嗡嗡飛舞。

examples.en: I heard the hum of the air conditioner all night.
examples.zh: 我整晚都聽到冷氣的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: A low hum came from the old computer.
examples.zh: 那台舊電腦傳來低沉的嗡嗡聲。

examples.en: The hum of voices filled the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡充滿了嗡嗡的說話聲。

examples.en: The farmer kept his tools in a small wooden hut.
examples.zh: 農夫把工具放在一間小木屋裡。

examples.en: We stayed in a mountain hut during the hike.
examples.zh: 健行時我們住在山上的小屋。

examples.en: The fishing village has a few huts near the beach.
examples.zh: 這座漁村在海灘附近有幾間小屋。

examples.en: The road was icy, so the bus drove slowly.
examples.zh: 路面結冰，所以公車開得很慢。

examples.en: An icy wind blew across the empty playground.
examples.zh: 冰冷的風吹過空蕩蕩的操場。

examples.en: She gave him an icy look and walked away.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地看了他一眼，然後走開了。

examples.en: Children have a great imagination.
examples.zh: 孩子們有很棒的想像力。

examples.en: This story asks you to use your imagination to build a new world.
examples.zh: 這個故事讓你運用想像力建構出一個新世界。

examples.en: The monster was only in his imagination.
examples.zh: 那隻怪物只存在於他的想像中。

examples.en: The doctor asked for immediate help from the nurses.
examples.zh: 醫師要求護理師立即提供協助。

examples.en: Our immediate goal is to finish the report by noon.
examples.zh: 我們眼前的目標是在中午前完成這份報告。

examples.en: Only the immediate family came to the small party.
examples.zh: 只有直系親屬來參加這場小聚會。

examples.en: Her speech impressed everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的演講讓房裡的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: He wore a suit to impress the interviewer.
examples.zh: 他穿西裝想給面試官留下好印象。

examples.en: The students were impressed by the new science lab.
examples.zh: 學生們對新的科學實驗室印象深刻。

examples.en: We built an indoor swimming pool at the gym.
examples.zh: 健身房裡蓋了一座室內游泳池。

examples.en: The school has many indoor activities for rainy days.
examples.zh: 學校為雨天準備了許多室內活動。

examples.en: My mother keeps an indoor plant near the window.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在窗邊放了一盆室內植物。

examples.en: It rained all day, so we stayed indoors.
examples.zh: 下了一整天的雨，所以我們待在室內。

examples.en: Please take the dog indoors before the storm starts.
examples.zh: 暴風雨開始前請把狗帶進屋內。

examples.en: Children should not play indoors all the time.
examples.zh: 孩子們不該老是待在室內玩。

examples.en: The city has a large industrial area near the harbor.
examples.zh: 這座城市在港口附近有一大片工業區。

examples.en: Industrial waste must be treated before it enters the river.
examples.zh: 工業廢棄物在排入河川前必須先處理。

examples.en: He works for an industrial company that makes machines.
examples.zh: 他在一家製造機器的工業公司上班。

examples.en: This copy is inferior to the original in quality.
examples.zh: 這份複製品的品質比不上原版。

examples.en: Nobody should feel inferior because of their background.
examples.zh: 沒有人該因為出身而覺得自己不如人。

examples.en: The store was fined for selling inferior products.
examples.zh: 這家店因販售劣質商品而被罰款。

examples.en: Please inform me if the meeting time changes.
examples.zh: 如果會議時間有變，請通知我。

examples.en: The school informed parents about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 學校把新的時間表告知了家長。

examples.en: She was informed that her flight had been delayed.
examples.zh: 她被告知班機延誤了。

examples.en: We stayed at a small inn near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們住在湖邊的一間小旅館。

examples.en: The inn serves breakfast to all guests.
examples.zh: 這間旅館供應所有房客早餐。

examples.en: The travelers had dinner at an old inn by the road.
examples.zh: 旅人們在路邊一家老客棧吃了晚餐。

examples.en: The inner wall of the house is painted white.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的內牆漆成白色。

examples.en: She tried to find her inner strength.
examples.zh: 她努力找回內心的力量。

examples.en: The inner circle of the park is closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 公園的內圈因維修而封閉。

examples.en: The judge decided that the young man was innocent.
examples.zh: 法官認定這名年輕人是無辜的。

examples.en: The little girl gave an innocent smile.
examples.zh: 小女孩露出天真的微笑。

examples.en: It was an innocent mistake, so nobody was angry.
examples.zh: 那只是無心的失誤，所以沒有人生氣。

examples.en: The mechanic will inspect the car before you drive it.
examples.zh: 技師會在你開車前檢查這輛車。

examples.en: Officers inspect the bags at the airport.
examples.zh: 機場的人員會檢查行李。

examples.en: The principal inspected the new classrooms yesterday.
examples.zh: 校長昨天視察了新教室。

examples.en: The health inspector visited the restaurant this morning.
examples.zh: 衛生檢查員今天早上來到這間餐廳。

examples.en: The inspector checked every room of the building.
examples.zh: 檢查員查看了大樓的每個房間。

examples.en: A ticket inspector walked through the train.
examples.zh: 一位查票員走過火車車廂。

examples.en: The inventor showed us his new machine.
examples.zh: 這位發明家向我們展示他的新機器。

examples.en: Who was the inventor of the telephone?
examples.zh: 電話的發明者是誰？

examples.en: My uncle is an inventor who makes small tools.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個製作小工具的發明家。

examples.en: The old piano keys were made of ivory.
examples.zh: 這架老鋼琴的琴鍵是用象牙做的。

examples.en: Selling ivory is against the law in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，販售象牙是違法的。

examples.en: She chose a dress in soft ivory for the wedding.
examples.zh: 她為婚禮挑了一件柔和象牙白的洋裝。

examples.en: The old jail has been turned into a museum.
examples.zh: 這座舊監獄已被改建成博物館。

examples.en: The thief spent a year in jail.
examples.zh: 那名小偷在監獄裡待了一年。

examples.en: The tour guide showed us a small jail from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 導覽員帶我們看了一座十九世紀的小監獄。

examples.en: My grandmother keeps cookies in a glass jar.
examples.zh: 我奶奶把餅乾放在玻璃罐裡。

examples.en: Please pass me the jar of peanut butter.
examples.zh: 請把那罐花生醬遞給我。

examples.en: She filled the jar with water and put the flowers in it.
examples.zh: 她在罐子裡裝滿水，再把花插進去。

examples.en: I ate a jelly sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐吃了一個果醬三明治。

examples.en: The children enjoyed the fruit jelly after dinner.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡晚餐後的水果果凍。

examples.en: Spread some jelly on the toast, please.
examples.zh: 請在吐司上塗一點果醬。

examples.en: The jet took off from the runway at noon.
examples.zh: 噴射機中午從跑道起飛。

examples.en: A private jet landed at the small airport.
examples.zh: 一架私人噴射機降落在這座小機場。

examples.en: Water shot out of the jet and cooled the garden.
examples.zh: 水從噴口射出，為花園降溫。

examples.en: The queen wore a crown covered with jewels.
examples.zh: 女王戴著鑲滿寶石的皇冠。

examples.en: The thief stole a rare jewel from the museum.
examples.zh: 小偷從博物館偷走了一顆稀有的寶石。

examples.en: She keeps her favorite jewel in a small box.
examples.zh: 她把最愛的寶石收在一個小盒子裡。

examples.en: She wears very little jewelry to work.
examples.zh: 她上班時很少戴首飾。

examples.en: The shop sells silver jewelry at fair prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售銀飾。

examples.en: He bought a piece of jewelry for his mother.
examples.zh: 他為媽媽買了一件首飾。

examples.en: The journey from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的旅程大約要兩個小時。

examples.en: We wished him a safe journey before he left.
examples.zh: 他出發前，我們祝他一路平安。

examples.en: The long journey made the children sleepy.
examples.zh: 漫長的旅程讓孩子們昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: The joyful children ran into the playground.
examples.zh: 開心的孩子們跑進遊樂場。

examples.en: It was a joyful day for the whole family.
examples.zh: 那是全家人歡樂的一天。

examples.en: Her joyful voice filled the room with laughter.
examples.zh: 她歡樂的聲音讓房裡充滿笑聲。

examples.en: This peach is sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 這顆桃子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: He took a bite of the juicy orange.
examples.zh: 他咬了一口多汁的柳橙。

examples.en: My mother cooked a juicy steak for dinner.
examples.zh: 我媽媽晚餐煎了一塊多汁的牛排。

examples.en: Many rare animals live in the jungle.
examples.zh: 許多稀有動物生活在叢林裡。

examples.en: The explorers walked through the thick jungle for days.
examples.zh: 探險家們在茂密的叢林中走了好幾天。

examples.en: We watched a film about the jungle in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上看了一部關於叢林的影片。

senses.zh: 資淺的；年少的；低年級的

examples.en: She is a junior member of the sales team.
examples.zh: 她是業務團隊裡資淺的成員。

examples.en: My brother goes to junior high school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟就讀國中。

examples.en: The junior players practice before the older ones.
examples.zh: 年紀較小的選手比年長的選手先練習。

examples.en: He is three years my junior.
examples.zh: 他比我小三歲。

examples.en: As a junior in college, she studies economics.
examples.zh: 身為大三學生，她主修經濟學。

examples.en: The juniors helped the seniors prepare the event.
examples.zh: 學弟妹幫學長姊籌備活動。
